impact: ConnectionManager::createFromGroup($group, $table = 'servers') and createFromTags($tags, $table = 'servers') query 'group' and 'tags' columns on a table named servers. dply's servers table has neither column, so both throw 'column does not exist' when called with their defaults - as does DispatchesTaskRunnerToServers::dispatchToGroup/dispatchToTaggedServers, which pass the same default through. The default is inherited from the upstream task-runner package, whose servers schema had those columns. No production code calls them with the default today, so nothing is broken in practice, but the signature advertises a capability that cannot work as written. Either drop the default so callers must name a table, or map group/tags onto something dply's servers table actually has.
resolution:
Fixed by dropping the `$table = 'servers'` default rather than mapping group/tags onto dply's schema — dply's servers table has neither a `group` nor a `tags` column, so no mapping exists to make the default meaningful.

`ConnectionManager::createFromGroup(string $groupName, string $table)` and `createFromTags(array $tags, string $table)` now require the table, with a docblock on createFromGroup recording why the default was removed (inherited from the upstream package's schema; could only ever throw here). `DispatchesTaskRunnerToServers::dispatchToGroup()` and `dispatchToTaggedServers()` likewise require `string $table` and pass it through, so the defect cannot re-enter via the dispatch path. Callers must now name a table that actually carries the column.

The code change landed in commit 94ea1c4f5 ("Require the table for group/tag dispatch, and stop orphaning parked webservers"); this session verified it against HEAD and closed the ledger entry.

Also corrected in this session: app/Modules/TaskRunner/md/CONNECTION_FEATURES.md still demonstrated both calls against `'servers'`, i.e. the exact call that throws on dply. The examples now name a hypothetical `task_runner_hosts` and state the column requirement, so the docs no longer advertise the capability the signature change just withdrew.

Verified: `vendor/bin/pest app/Modules/TaskRunner/Tests/ConnectionManagerTest.php` — 100 passed, 134 assertions. Run directly rather than via `composer test`, since the Modules suite is excluded from defaultTestSuite and a default run would not have executed this code at all.
title: createFromGroup/createFromTags default to a servers table dply does not have
